title: Shellwright app configuration
description: The single source of truth for a generated app. Every native project, cache key, and studio form is derived from this document.

$schema.title: Schema URL
$schema.description: Points editors at the schema so hand-written configs get autocomplete and inline help.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Which version of this schema the document was written against. Drives migration; never edit by hand.

linkRules.title: Link rules
linkRules.description: Ordered rules deciding where each link opens. The first matching rule wins, so put specific patterns above general ones and end with a catch-all.

nativeSurfaces.title: Native surfaces
nativeSurfaces.description: Fully native screens rendered outside the web view, such as onboarding or a settings page. These are what make the app more than a repackaged website.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Native capabilities to include, keyed by plugin id. Each value is validated against that plugin's own configuration schema.

^x-.title: Extension object
^x-.description: An escape hatch for data this schema does not model. Ignored by code generation and excluded from every cache key.

App.title: App identity
App.description: Who the app is and where it starts. These values appear in the stores and cannot be changed casually after publication.

name.title: App name
name.description: The name shown under the icon and on your store listing. The App Store truncates beyond 30 characters.

bundleId.title: Bundle identifier
bundleId.description: Reverse-DNS identifier, lowercase only. This is permanent — neither Apple nor Google lets you change it after the first release.

versionName.title: Version name
versionName.description: The version customers see, for example 1.4.0. Up to three dot-separated numbers.

versionCode.title: Version code
versionCode.description: The internal build number. Must increase with every store upload; Google Play rejects anything above 2100000000.

initialUrl.title: Start URL
initialUrl.description: The page the app opens on. Must be https — both platforms block plain http by default.

allowedOrigins.title: Allowed origins
allowedOrigins.description: Origins treated as part of your app. The JavaScript bridge is injected only on these, and anything else is treated as an external link.

Branding.title: Branding
Branding.description: Icon, splash screen, and colours. Changing anything here rebuilds resources only, which is far faster than a full recompile.

icon.title: App icon
icon.description: Source icon, at least 1024x1024, square, with no transparency. Every store density is generated from it.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.description: Whether the app follows the device setting or pins itself to one appearance.

Splash.title: Splash screen
Splash.description: What shows while the app starts. Keep it simple — it is on screen for under a second.

backgroundColor.title: Background colour
backgroundColor.description: Fills the screen behind the logo.

logo.title: Splash logo
logo.description: Centred on the splash background, inside the safe area.

dark.title: Dark appearance overrides
dark.description: Replaces the splash colours when the device is in dark mode.

backgroundColor.title: Dark background colour
backgroundColor.description: Splash background used in dark mode.

logo.title: Dark splash logo
logo.description: Splash logo used in dark mode.

Theme.title: Theme colours
Theme.description: The native chrome around your website. Match these to your site so the seam is invisible.

primary.title: Primary colour
primary.description: Accent colour for controls, the refresh spinner, and selected tabs.

navBar.title: Top bar colour
navBar.description: Background of the native top bar.

tabBar.title: Tab bar colour
tabBar.description: Background of the native bottom tab bar.

statusBar.title: Status bar style
statusBar.description: Controls the colour of the clock and battery icons. Pick the one that contrasts with your top bar.

Navigation.title: Navigation
Navigation.description: The native chrome. At least one of these should be enabled — an app with no native navigation is very likely to be rejected under App Store guideline 4.2.

TopBar.title: Top bar
TopBar.description: The native bar across the top of the screen.

enabled.title: Show the top bar
enabled.description: Turn off for a full-bleed layout where your website supplies its own header.

titleSource.title: Title source
titleSource.description: Where the bar's title comes from: the page's title tag, a fixed string, or nothing.

staticTitle.title: Fixed title
staticTitle.description: Used when the title source is set to a fixed string.

actions.title: Action buttons
actions.description: Buttons on the right of the top bar, shown in order.

type.title: Action type
type.description: Built-in actions need no wiring. Choose 'custom' to receive a callback in your JavaScript instead.

label.title: Accessibility label
label.description: Read aloud by screen readers. Required for custom actions.

TabBar.title: Bottom tab bar
TabBar.description: The strongest signal to a store reviewer that this is an app rather than a website.

enabled.title: Show the tab bar
enabled.description: Turn on to show a native bottom tab bar.

items.title: Tabs
items.description: Up to five tabs. iOS collapses anything beyond five into a 'More' tab, which reads poorly.

label.title: Tab label
label.description: Keep it to one short word; the tab bar is narrow.

icon.title: Tab icon
icon.description: A built-in icon name or an uploaded image.

url.title: Destination
url.description: Where the tab navigates. A path is resolved against your start URL.

activePattern.title: Active while
activePattern.description: Regular expression deciding when this tab shows as selected.

Drawer.title: Side drawer
Drawer.description: A slide-out menu, useful when you have more destinations than fit in a tab bar.

enabled.title: Show the drawer
enabled.description: Turn on to add a slide-out navigation menu.

url.title: Destination
url.description: Where the item navigates. Omit for a section heading.

section.title: Section
section.description: Groups items under a shared heading in the menu.

LinkRule.title: Link rule
LinkRule.description: Matches a URL and decides where it opens.

action.title: Open in
action.description: Where a matching link opens: inside the app, in a modal, in a reader view, in the device browser, or blocked entirely.

WebOverrides.title: Web overrides
WebOverrides.description: Adjustments applied to your website when it runs inside the app.

userAgentSuffix.title: User agent suffix
userAgentSuffix.description: Appended to the browser user agent so your server can detect the app.

headers.title: Extra request headers
headers.description: Sent with every page request the app makes. Never put a secret here — the config is stored, hashed, and exportable.

injectCss.title: Injected stylesheet
injectCss.description: CSS applied on every page, useful for hiding your website's own header.

injectJs.title: Injected script
injectJs.description: JavaScript run on every page, after the bridge is available.

persistCookies.title: Keep users signed in
persistCookies.description: Preserves cookies between launches so users are not signed out every time.

allowZoom.title: Allow pinch zoom
allowZoom.description: Lets users pinch to zoom. Leave off for app-like behaviour, on for accessibility.

pullToRefresh.title: Pull to refresh
pullToRefresh.description: Adds the native pull-down gesture to reload the page.

Offline.title: Offline behaviour
Offline.description: What the app does with no connection. A blank screen is a common reason for store rejection.

enabled.title: Handle offline
enabled.description: Show a branded offline screen instead of a browser error.

offlinePage.title: Offline page
offlinePage.description: Your own HTML shown when there is no connection.

fallbackBundle.title: Offline bundle
fallbackBundle.description: Which pages to cache for offline use: none, chosen automatically, or a bundle you supply.

showOnce.title: Show only once
showOnce.description: Displays on first launch only, then never again.

config.title: Surface configuration
config.description: Content for this surface, validated against the surface type's own schema.

Ota.title: Over-the-air updates
Ota.description: Ship web bundle changes without waiting for store review.

enabled.title: Enable OTA updates
enabled.description: Lets the app fetch new web bundles on launch.

channel.title: Release channel
channel.description: Which stream of updates this build follows.

rolloutPercent.title: Rollout percentage
rolloutPercent.description: Share of users who receive the update. Start small and raise it once you see clean crash numbers.

DeepLinks.title: Deep links
DeepLinks.description: Lets links to your website open directly in the app.

universalLinks.title: Linked domains
universalLinks.description: Domains whose links open in the app. Each needs a verification file hosted at its root.

customScheme.title: Custom URL scheme
customScheme.description: A private scheme such as 'acme', giving you acme:// links. Lowercase letters and digits only.

Permissions.title: Permissions
Permissions.description: Device capabilities the app may ask for. Request only what you use — an unjustified permission is a common rejection cause.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Needed for photo capture and barcode scanning.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Needed for audio recording and video calls.

photoLibrary.title: Photo library
photoLibrary.description: Needed to attach existing photos to web forms.

location.title: Location
location.description: Choose 'whenInUse' unless you genuinely track location in the background — 'always' invites extra store scrutiny.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Needed to read the device address book.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Needed to read or add calendar events.

biometric.title: Face ID and fingerprint
biometric.description: Needed to unlock the app with biometrics.

Build.title: Build settings
Build.description: Toolchain and platform floors. Leave these alone unless a plugin requires a change.

minSdk.title: Minimum Android version
minSdk.description: API level 24 is Android 7.0 and covers almost every active device.

targetSdk.title: Target Android version
targetSdk.description: Google requires this to stay near the latest release.

minVersion.title: Minimum iOS version
minVersion.description: The oldest iOS release the app installs on.

orientation.title: Screen orientation
orientation.description: Which way the app may rotate.

maximumWindows.title: Maximum open windows
maximumWindows.description: Caps how many modal web views can stack. Each one holds memory, so keep it low.

Color.title: Colour
Color.description: A hex colour, with optional alpha, for example #2563EB or #2563EBFF.

AssetRef.title: Asset reference
AssetRef.description: A content-addressed pointer to an uploaded file. The studio fills this in when you upload; identical files are stored once.

IconRef.title: Icon
IconRef.description: Either a built-in icon name such as 'home', or an uploaded image.

oneOf.title: Built-in icon
oneOf.description: Name from the built-in icon set.

ItemId.title: Item identifier
ItemId.description: A stable id used to track this item across edits. Generated for you; changing it is treated as deleting and re-adding.

LocalizedString.title: Text
LocalizedString.description: Either plain text, or an object of translations keyed by language code with a 'default' entry.

oneOf.title: Translations
oneOf.description: Per-language text. 'default' is used for any language not listed.

UrlPattern.title: URL pattern
UrlPattern.description: A regular expression matched against the full URL. Use .* to match everything.

UrlOrPath.title: URL or path
UrlOrPath.description: A full https URL, or a path such as /orders resolved against your start URL.

HttpsUrl.title: Secure URL
HttpsUrl.description: A full https URL. Plain http is blocked by both platforms.

HttpsOrigin.title: Secure origin
HttpsOrigin.description: Scheme, host, and optional port, with no path — for example https://app.acme.com.
